description:
Run the right lint/format/type/test gates BEFORE committing or pushing. Sniffs the current repo's stack (poetry/uv/yarn/pnpm/go/rust) and runs the correct commands. Blocks commit if any gate is red.
Trigger this skill when: - User says "commit", "ready to push", "prep for PR", "preflight", or invokes
  `/preflight`.
- After a batch of edits before the user asks for a commit. - Before running `git commit`.
